description: Activate/deactivate a test app secret key or select it for webhooks. Supply active and/or usedForWebhooks as booleans. Select an active replacement before unselecting or deactivating the current webhook key. Returns metadata only.

active.description: Whether the key is valid for authentication.

id.description: The full 12-character ID returned by list_secret_keys.

usedForWebhooks.description: Select an active key for webhook signing, replacing the current selection.
